clue.text: Finding fault with service-enough to trigger a reaction

parts.note: finding fault with something is being critical of it
Mass is the Eucharistic church service

explanation.surface: Someone's carping at a church service is enough to set off an angry response.
explanation.definitionFit: In physics, the minimum amount of fissile material needed to sustain a chain reaction is this quantity.

clue.text: Rice dish recipe is taken by German emperor

parts.note: R is the standard abbreviation for recipe (Latin 'take') on prescriptions
taken as written
Otto the Great was a German Holy Roman Emperor

explanation.surface: A German emperor helps himself to a cook's instructions for a rice dish.
explanation.definitionFit: An Italian dish of rice cooked slowly in stock is this.

clue.text: House rows with Her Majesty in evidence

indicators.note: the royal letters are placed in the middle of the word for evidence

parts.note: traces are signs left behind, evidence
ER stands for Elizabeth Regina, the Queen

explanation.surface: Rows of houses where signs of the Queen's presence can be seen.
explanation.definitionFit: Rows of joined houses along a street are called terraces in Britain.

clue.text: Team with cox emulated cocks

definitions.meaning: a rowing team steered by a coxswain
did as roosters do, crowed, past tense

explanation.surface: A rowing squad and its coxswain behaved like roosters.
explanation.definitionFit: A rowing boat's oarsmen form a crew; and 'crew' is an old past tense of crow, the sound roosters make.

clue.text: A dearth of music in Arkansas

parts.note: a dearth of something is very little of it
rock is a genre of popular music

explanation.surface: A complaint that there is hardly any music to be heard in Arkansas.
explanation.definitionFit: The state capital of Arkansas is the city with this name.

clue.text: People from Basra?

indicators.note: the people are made from the letters of the city name, which signals rearranging them

explanation.surface: A simple question about who lives in the Iraqi city of Basra.
explanation.definitionFit: Basra is in Iraq, an Arab country, so its inhabitants are largely of Arab ethnicity.

clue.text: Sort that is seen in glasses

indicators.note: the abbreviation is placed within the word for glasses, as if seen through them

parts.note: specs is short for spectacles, glasses
i.e. is the abbreviation of id est, that is

explanation.surface: A remark about what type of thing appears in a pair of spectacles.
explanation.definitionFit: A species is a kind or type, as in 'a rare species of honesty'.

clue.text: Movie plot says "Bar embryo"

indicators.note: to plot is to scheme or arrange, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A film's storyline sums itself up as a ban on an embryo.
explanation.walkthrough: 'plot' reads as the film's storyline but is the anagram signal on SAYS BAR EMBRYO.
explanation.definitionFit: Polanski's 1968 horror film about a woman carrying the devil's child has this title.

clue.text: Getting lower status

definitions.meaning: grasping or comprehending, as in 'getting the joke'
a standing that is beneath others

explanation.surface: Being demoted to a lesser rank.
explanation.definitionFit: Comprehension is one sense; split in two, the word also describes a standing that is beneath, a lower position.

clue.text: Watch, say

explanation.surface: A two-word instruction to look and to speak.
explanation.definitionFit: To watch carefully is one sense; to remark, as in 'he observed that it was late', is the other.

clue.text: Scoot back with a German used car?

indicators.note: back signals that the word for scoot is read in reverse

parts.note: to dart is to dash or scoot
ein is German for a

explanation.surface: Someone tells a German to speed off in reverse in a second-hand car.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns DART into TRAD. The definition is fair because a car handed over as part-payment for a new one is used.
explanation.definitionFit: An old car given in part-exchange for another is offered in this way, so the questioned phrase describes it by example.

clue.text: Out of context rather more than is necessary

indicators.note: the answer is taken out of the run of letters across the two words

explanation.surface: Something quoted out of context, more than needed.
explanation.definitionFit: Something superfluous, beyond what is needed, is extra.

clue.text: Material for sealings?

parts.note: a glazed translucent paper used to make envelopes and seals for stamps and food; the question mark flags the punning sense of sealing with a glassy material

explanation.surface: A question about what to make seals from.
explanation.definitionFit: This thin glossy, grease-resistant paper is used for sealed envelopes and wrappers.

clue.text: Note pretty woman with a resistance to Clinton

parts.note: doll is slang for an attractive woman
R is the symbol for electrical resistance
Bill Clinton, the US president

explanation.surface: A message about an attractive woman who opposes Bill Clinton.
explanation.definitionFit: A piece of US paper money worth one dollar is a banknote of this kind.

clue.text: Honest as chairman

definitions.meaning: positioned over the board of directors, as its chairman is

explanation.surface: A tribute to the integrity of a company's chairman.
explanation.definitionFit: Legitimate and open dealing is one sense; read literally, a chairman sits at the head of, over, the company board.

clue.text: A goddess lives twice

indicators.note: twice says the short word for lives is written two times

parts.note: is means exists or lives

explanation.surface: A divine being has two lives.
explanation.definitionFit: The Egyptian mother goddess, wife of Osiris, bore this name.

clue.text: Hugs for couple in German river

indicators.note: the word for a pair is placed within the river's name

parts.note: the Ems flows through north-west Germany
a brace is a pair, especially of game birds

explanation.surface: A pair of lovers embrace beside a river in Germany.
explanation.definitionFit: To embrace someone is to hug them.

clue.text: Time for agreement on the ending of war

parts.note: yea is an old word of assent, yes

indicators.note: the ending of a word is its last letter

explanation.surface: A peace accord timed for the close of hostilities.
explanation.definitionFit: Twelve months is a period of time.

clue.text: Article by Mrs Copperfield about Micawber's ultimate state

parts.note: an is the indefinite article

indicators.note: Dora's name goes about, around, the letter taken from Micawber

parts.note: Dora Spenlow is David Copperfield's first wife in Dickens's novel

indicators.note: ultimate means last, so the final letter of the name

explanation.surface: A literary piece by Dickens's Dora Copperfield about Mr Micawber's final circumstances.
explanation.walkthrough: 'state' looks like a condition, as in Micawber's financial state, but it is a country.
explanation.definitionFit: The small principality in the Pyrenees between France and Spain is an independent state.

clue.text: Girl going by jet or prison van

parts.note: jet black is deep black, so jet means black
Maria is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A girl goes off by jet plane or else by police van.
explanation.definitionFit: A police vehicle for carrying prisoners is known by this old slang name.

clue.text: Opportunity to renew old acquaintanceships, producing ennui or embarrassment

indicators.note: embarrassment suggests confusion and disorder, so the letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: A get-together with old friends can bring boredom or awkwardness.
explanation.definitionFit: A gathering of people who have not met for a long time, such as old classmates, is this.

clue.text: Wait for Devon leader in a Devon town

parts.note: to bide is to wait, as in 'bide your time'
taken as written

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: Waiting for the head of the county to arrive in a Devon town.
explanation.definitionFit: This small port on the River Torridge in north Devon is a town in that county.

clue.text: Father's trouble, being weak and infirm

parts.note: Fr is the abbreviation for Father, a priest's title
to ail is to trouble or afflict

explanation.surface: A father's illness has left him weak and sickly.
explanation.definitionFit: Feeble and in poor health are both senses of frail.

clue.text: Some applause for part of the contest

definitions.meaning: one stage of a competition, as in boxing or golf

explanation.surface: A ripple of clapping for a stage in the competition.
explanation.definitionFit: A spell of clapping and a single stage of a match share this one word.

clue.text: A retreat from a former British colony

parts.note: a den is a private retreat or lair

explanation.surface: British forces withdrawing from one of the old colonies.
explanation.definitionFit: This Yemeni port city was a British colony until 1967.

clue.text: One bone turned over and over in a curry

indicators.note: turned over says the letters for one and bone are read in reverse

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
a rib is a bone

indicators.note: the second over reverses the two little words that follow it

explanation.surface: A single bone flipped round and round in a pot of curry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turned over' reverses I + RIB to make BIRI, and the second 'over' reverses IN A to make ANI.
explanation.definitionFit: A spiced Indian rice dish with meat or vegetables is a kind of curry, more often spelt biryani.

clue.text: Zodiac sign omitted from works of reference, in a manner of speaking

indicators.note: the star sign is left out of the longer word for reference books

parts.note: dictionaries are reference books
Aries, the ram, is a sign of the zodiac

explanation.surface: Horoscopes left out of encyclopedias and such, so to speak.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in a manner of speaking' looks like a throwaway phrase, but 'a manner of speaking' is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: One's enunciation or choice of words, one's style of speaking, is one's diction.

clue.text: Have ye all sung and recollected old times?

indicators.note: re-collected, gathered up again in a new order, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A New Year's Eve question: has everyone sung and remembered days gone by?
explanation.walkthrough: 'recollected' reads as remembered but splits as re-collected, the anagram signal on YE ALL SUNG AND.
explanation.definitionFit: The Scots phrase means 'days long since', old times, and is the title of the New Year song.
